# Demo script

- Use a mocked or authorized public-data fixture that can be reproduced.
- Show the input query command or API call and resulting trend sentiment or summary output.
- State provider scope timestamp and classifier limitation.
- Avoid exposing tokens user identifiers or unnecessary raw content.
- Do not imply platform-wide coverage from a limited sample.
- Verify the workflow from a clean checkout before publishing.
